reflection. For each transformation type, students write the new function in terms of the parent
function, graph the function using technology, and then generalize the effect of the a- or d-value
in the new equation.

of f(x) is translated right or left. When c . 0, the graph is translated to the right; when c , 0, the
graph is translated to the left.
